assets.name: 챌린저
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, production game rank emblem.
Create ONE premium CHALLENGER rank emblem for an existing Korean competitive fantasy game. Square 1024x1024 RGBA PNG, genuinely transparent alpha background. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, panel or scenery.
Primary design: TWO GLADIATOR HELMETS side by side, equal stature, very clearly recognizable classical gladiator armor with strong angular T-shaped eye visors, cheek guards and sweeping helmet crests. Left helmet is a left-facing three-quarter profile and right helmet is a right-facing three-quarter profile, forming a back-to-back DUO alliance. Keep the helmets separate and anatomically convincing, neither merged into a face, wings, heart nor single mask. Each helmet occupies a large readable area. No visible person, face or skin.
This is an elite competitive rank insignia, victorious and martial. Helmet shells are carefully sculpted antique gold and warm champagne metal over dark gunmetal recessed visors, with restrained azure-blue enamel accents on crest ridges. A SMALL angular crown joins the outer surround above the two helmet crests. Short symmetrical architectural side plates and a compact pointed lower shield rim unify the two helmets as one badge, but the paired helmets dominate at least 65% of its area. A subtle crossed-sword detail behind the helmets is optional and must remain minor.
Style: premium hand-painted 2D game icon with disciplined shapes, exceptionally clean controlled contours, strong hierarchy, rich light/shadow and convincing metal thickness. Sophisticated weapon armor design. Sculptural 3/4 helmets with front-facing badge composition. Beautiful and readable at 64px, impressive at 256px.
Avoid: any heart silhouette, heart jewel, twin teardrop crystals, cute romance/couple imagery, giant glowing gems, excessive fluffy wings, thin decorative curls, jewelry-like ornate filigree, oversaturated bloom, photo or 3D render, a generic repeating shield. No orange fire, particles or glow outside the solid silhouette.
Composition: full icon centered, entire crown and crests visible, broad balanced silhouette, 10–12% transparent margin on all sides. Crisp genuine alpha edges and no background shadow plane.
